title: CHEED SCRIPT
script:
wait(2)
local players = game.Players
local chat = game:GetService("Chat")
local name = "SsTeP1337"
local player : Player = players:FindFirstChild(name)

local function color(obj)
	obj.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
	obj.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0)
	obj.BorderSizePixel = 2
	obj.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
	local size = Instance.new("UIGridLayout", obj)
	size.CellSize = UDim2.new(0, 72, 0, 50)
	size.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5)
end

local function color2(obj, text)
	obj.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
	obj.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0)
	obj.BorderSizePixel = 2
	obj.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
	obj.TextSize = 10
	obj.Text = text
	local size = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint", obj)
	size.MaxTextSize = 10
end

local function spawngui()
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player.PlayerGui)
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = true
	local frame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", gui)
	color(frame)
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(0.267, 0, 0.500, 0)
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.663, 0, 0.015, 0)
	frame.Active = true
	frame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	local killbutton = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
	color2(killbutton, "KillAll")
	local firebutton = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
	color2(firebutton, "FireAll")
	local skybutton = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
	color2(skybutton, "Skybox")
	local musbutton = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
	color2(musbutton, "Music")
	local messagebutton = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
	color2(messagebutton, "Message")
	local screamerbutton = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
	color2(screamerbutton, "Screamer")

	killbutton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		for i, v in pairs(players:GetChildren()) do
			if v.Name ~= name then
				v.Character.Humanoid:TakeDamage(100)
			end
		end
	end)
	firebutton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		for i, v in pairs(players:GetChildren()) do
			if v.Name ~= name then
				local fire = Instance.new("Fire", v.Character.Head)
				fire.Size = 10
				fire.Heat = 10
			end
		end
	end)
	local function skybox(sky : Sky)
		sky.SkyboxBk = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=16841788422"
		sky.SkyboxFt = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=16841788422"
		sky.SkyboxLf = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=16841788422"
		sky.SkyboxRt = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=16841788422"
		sky.SkyboxDn = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=16841788422"
		sky.SkyboxUp = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=16841788422"
	end
	skybutton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		local sky = game.Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")
		if sky then
			skybox(sky)
		else
			local sky = Instance.new("Sky", game.Lighting)
			skybox(sky)
		end
	end)
	musbutton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		local sound = Instance.new("Sound", game.Workspace)
		sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://844208899"
		sound.Looped = true
		sound:Play()
		local sound = Instance.new("Sound", game.Workspace)
		sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://2738830850"
		sound.Looped = true
		sound:Play()
	end)
	messagebutton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		for i, v in pairs(players:GetChildren()) do
			if v.Name ~= name then
				game:GetService("Chat"):Chat(v.Character.Head, "CHEEDABOB IS GOD!!!")
				game:GetService("Chat"):Chat(v.Character.Head, "CHEEDABOB IS GOD!!!")
				game:GetService("Chat"):Chat(v.Character.Head, "CHEEDABOB IS GOD!!!")
			end
		end
	end)
	screamerbutton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		local sound = Instance.new("Sound", game.Workspace)
		sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://7236490488"
		sound:Play()
		wait(sound.TimeLength)
		sound:Destroy()
	end)

	player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Died:Connect(function()
		gui:Destroy()
		wait(6)
		spawngui()
		return
	end)
end

spawngui()
